chronicle.text: Mairum came back for food left 4 weeks before, and it was still there.
Mairum survived an attack by wolves.
Habem attacked Zaititik: the first violence.
Layizun found that what Goubei had told them was wrong, and trusted them less for it.
Thekek went back to what they had left in one spot a third time, to see it happen again: the first deliberate testing.
Deideirou gathered food that had grown where seeds had been dropped: the first harvest from seed left in the ground.
Bebisik tied wood and wood together with fiber and was left with something that floats and carries someone across water: the first raft.
Bebisik crossed open water on something that floats and came ashore on land nobody could walk to from where they set out.
Yaikeidoun drank from the sea and it did not quench their thirst.
Habem struck flint with flint and stared at what happened.
Habem struck flint with flint and was left with a sharp edge: the first blade.
Naikaik scratched a mark <\^\> into rock.
Deideirou buried seed on purpose, having seen it come back as food: the beginning of farming.
Mairum tied fiber and fiber together with fiber and was left with something to carry things in: the first carrier.
Habem told Zaititik that Layizun could be believed: reputation passed on by word.
Shaiho tied a bundle they had tied and a raft together with fiber and was left with something heavy on a handle: the first club.
Tamour crossed open water on something that floats and came ashore on land nobody could walk to from where they set out.
Zaititik took up striking flint with stone from a mark: the first thing learned from a record.
Zaititik came on the mark <..^> and took it to mean flint being struck: the first mark read as a message.
Deideirou struck flint where dry things lay, and they caught: the first fire made by people.
A hungry year: 3 people starved after a poor growing season.
Haitan crossed open water on something that floats and came ashore on land nobody could walk to from where they set out.
Naikaik tied a blade and wood together with fiber and was left with a sharp point on a long shaft: the first spear.
At (9, 3) the heap of things people had left grew big enough to keep out a fifth of the winter cold: the first dwelling. Kounein had put in the most.
Haitan set food aside on purpose, having found it there when it was needed before: the beginning of keeping stores.
Gukus tied a club and a carrier together with fiber and was left with something warm to wear: the first wrap.
Yuzi found that what the mark <o/.> seemed to say was wrong, and put less faith in that mark.
3 people now take the mark <-/\> to go with shelter, and have for two years. Nobody decided this; it grew from where the mark was made and seen.
Tamour crossed open water on something that floats and came ashore on land nobody could walk to from where they set out.

Years 0-24: population 20 to 10, 14 births. Deaths mostly from starvation (11), thirst (7), illness (4). Average happiness 0.69. Recorded: 6 inventions, 21 firsts, 1 famines, 7 band changes, 6 new exchange partnerships, 2 new settlements.
The mark <-/\> has drifted: it went with shelter, and now, for 7 people, with flint being struck.
The mark <-/\> has drifted: it went with flint being struck, and now, for 3 people, with shelter.
Years 25-49: population 10 to 2, 0 births. Deaths mostly from illness (3), old age (3), starvation (2). Average happiness 0.64. Recorded: 1 band changes, 1 new settlements.
Soureik crossed open water on something that floats and came ashore on land nobody could walk to from where they set out.
